rule_20_22_findings.finding: Present: HCP+L1+L2>=20, no quick-trick term. First/second-seat opening evaluation guidance; not production-used or authenticated. Arithmetic: 10 needs lengths sum 10, 11 needs 9, 12 needs 8; exceptions prevent deterministic OPEN/PASS.
